description: This file contains utility functions for managing element selection within a drawing or diagramming application, including filtering selected elements, handling frames, and managing selection state.

classes.name: LinearElementEditor
classes.description: Class for editing linear elements, such as lines or connectors.

methods.name: excludeElementsInFramesFromSelection
methods.description: Filters out elements that are contained within frames from a selection array.

methods.name: getElementsWithinSelection
methods.description: Returns elements within a specified selection rectangle, considering frames and containment.

methods.name: getVisibleAndNonSelectedElements
methods.description: Filters elements to those visible in the viewport and not currently selected.

methods.name: isSomeElementSelected
methods.description: Checks if any element is selected, with caching for performance.

methods.name: getSelectedElements
methods.description: Retrieves selected elements based on application state, with options for including bound text and frame elements.

methods.name: getTargetElements
methods.description: Determines the target elements based on current app state, including editing or new elements.

methods.name: makeNextSelectedElementIds
methods.description: Returns previous selected element IDs if unchanged, to optimize rendering.

methods.name: _getLinearElementEditor
methods.description: Creates a LinearElementEditor instance if a single linear element is selected.

methods.name: getSelectionStateForElements
methods.description: Generates selection state including linear element editor and group selections.
